description: Buy a credit pack (Stripe Checkout). Creates a Stripe Checkout session for a credit pack; open the returned url to pay. Credits are added when payment completes; GET /v1/billing/checkout/{id} follows it. Use it when your user wants more credits or a call answered insufficient_credits: give them the url, which opens Stripe Checkout in their browser. Nothing is charged until they pay there, and the credits are added when they do. Ask them which pack first.

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key with the same arguments returns the first call's result (its current state), never runs it twice. Default: derived from the other arguments, so an identical retry is already safe; pass a new value to run the same arguments again.

pack.description: Pack ID: 1k (1,000 credits, $14.00), 30k (30,000 credits, $59.00), 250k (250,000 credits, $379.00), 2m (2,000,000 credits, $1,499.00), starter_topup (5,000 credits, $14.00, for subscribers of the starter plan only), growth_topup (10,000 credits, $18.00, for subscribers of the growth plan only), scale_topup (15,000 credits, $25.00, for subscribers of the scale plan only).
